entities.name: 编码智能体 (coding agent)
entities.how_described: 本集主线：像 Claude Code 这类替你写代码的智能体，Conductor 就是同时管理一支编码智能体团队的应用；他主张给它们自由放养的空间、能自我复制、与人和智能体协作

evidence.quote: So instead of having a bunch of terminal windows for your cloud codes or your codexes or your whatever coding agent, you have one interface to manage them all.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.how_described: 本集核心话题之一：最优秀工程师的工作流原则；但警告别陷入「中智梗图」——问「为什么这个工作流不是默认的？」，没有真 alpha 就别过度优化工作流

evidence.quote: Give them a sandbox that won't get killed, where they can explore your code base, where they can work on really hard tasks, where they know that they're not going to get shut down when you close your laptop lid.

evidence.quote: The other thing that's important here is that once you give them a sandbox to play in that isn't confined to your laptop, there's a bunch of really cool stuff that you can build on top.

entities.name: 上下文 (context)
entities.how_described: 本集反复强调：要让智能体在公司里高效，就要尽可能多地给它关于你们具体工作方式的上下文——Claude MD 是加载进智能体上下文的信息，CIA 数据库是为了喂饱这头野兽

evidence.quote: It's like information that gets loaded into the agent's context every time they start working.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: For your agents to be effective in your company, you want them to have as much information and as much context as they can have about the way you guys specifically work.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
